title: Getting Started
description: Quick tour and hands-on Property Editor Events tutorial (no manual ui.on registration).

title: Panel Data — Shared Variables & Bindings
description: One-Page live motor workbench: edit typed shared data on the left and immediately watch synchronized bindings on the right; simulation only.

title: Widget Playground
description: Two-page simulation showing professional widgets and Property Editor-managed change, press, release and reset events.

title: Multiline and Rich Text Labels
description: Edit multiline Label text, choose plain or rich HTML formatting, and update from ui.set().

title: Panel JavaScript Timers — Interval & Timeout
description: Two pages: timer lifecycle and named Property Editor button handlers; timers remain native Qt-backed.

title: File I/O & Operator Dialogs
description: Simulation-safe CSV logger, JSON/binary file round trips, open/save grants and asynchronous operator prompts.

title: SQLite Database & Data Logging
description: Two-page SQLite logging and query demo with visually assigned operator actions and async SQL callbacks.

title: Embedded Images and Instruction Cards
description: Two-Page illustrated RC filter guide with a fully embedded schematic and editable Procedure, Warning, Information and Success cards.

title: JavaScript DSP Studio — Third-Party Libraries
description: Self-contained signal-processing workbench using Fraction.js, Pako, base64-js plus reusable FFT and filter modules; three live plots, no hardware output.

title: Chart Techniques and Analytics
description: Two Pages with analytics, cursor-ready plots, styling and log axes.

title: Analog Charts and Frequency
description: Three Pages: analog time-series, XY and FFT/frequency examples.

title: Digital Timing and Protocol Charts
description: Two Pages of synthetic logic and UART/SPI/I2C timing traces.

title: Mathematical Equations and Experiment Tables
description: Two-page educational example with TeX-style source preview, scripted numeric predictions, editable lab notes table, and CSV export.

title: Calibration Lookup — Editable Table
description: Editable two-column sensor calibration, validation, interpolation, transfer curve and logged results, with simulation-only safety.

title: Table-to-Plot — Limits and Observations
description: Enter X, nominal, observed and limit values; draw four XY curves, flag out-of-limit points and build a CSV-exportable summary. Simulation-only.

title: Table-Driven Wavegen — Multi-Trace Sweep
description: Operator-edited Wavegen recipe; each enabled row becomes a separate physical CH1 capture or MODEL ONLY trace, with limits and a result table.

title: Signal Lab — Wavegen and Scope
description: Control W1, preview waveforms, and capture Scope CH1.

title: AC Network Laboratory — Theory to Breadboard & AD3
description: Ten-Page interactive RC theory-to-AD3 laboratory: guided breadboard, physical CH1/CH2 Bode data, transparent least-squares mathematical derivation and source walkthrough, and synthetic/real curve-fit plus residual explorer.

title: RC Step Response — Exponential Fitting & Time Constant
description: Eleven-Page R/C differential-equation and square-wave laboratory, annotated exponential least-squares JavaScript, synthetic versus AD3 measurement, 63.2% crossing, residuals, export and comparison with the AC cutoff experiment.

title: AD3 Scope and Range Discovery
description: Capture CH1, measure signed DC/RMS, query supported SDK input ranges.

title: V+ / V− Power Supplies
description: Set and enable independent programmable supplies and inspect status.

title: Static Digital I/O
description: Set Z, LOW and HIGH per pin, read inputs and test a physical loopback.

title: Digital Input Test Station — Native Monitor
description: Three Pages: opt-in read-only StaticIO polling, debounced JavaScript callbacks and project-owned physical START/interlock test. No hardware actions on load.

title: Logic Analyzer
description: Capture 16-bit DigitalIn samples and display a timing chart.

title: Digital Clock / PWM
description: Generate hardware-timed DigitalOut clock and verify duty/frequency.

title: Quadrature Encoder + Index
description: Generate synchronized A/B/index and verify RPM and phase.

title: Multi-Channel Sequence Lab
description: Generate and verify binary, Gray and walking-one multi-pin sequences.

title: Automated Test Bench — Measurement Results
description: Two-Page simulation: tolerance-aware PASS/FAIL results, read-only measurement table, shared JavaScript runtime.

title: Automated Test Station — Project-Owned C++ Executive
description: Seven-page self-contained tutorial: project-owned Test Executive, two synchronized Run Information forms, JavaScript pending UUT readback, native numeric limits, Setup/Main/Cleanup and JSON/CSV reports.

title: AD3 Hardware Test Station — W1 to CH1
description: Real AD3 loopback with project-owned Setup/Main/Cleanup, one CH1 acquisition, four native numeric PASS/FAIL checks, UUT identity, archived JSON reports.

title: UART Protocol — Native SDK Terminal
description: Connect DIO0 to DIO1 through 1 kΩ for local loopback. Common ground. 3.3 V logic. Opening this Panel never drives pins. Controller API example; simulation safe.

title: SPI Protocol — Master Transactions
description: Loopback: DIO1 → 1 kΩ → DIO2. A real JEDEC flash requires compatible 3.3 V wiring and selected CS. No output on load. Controller API example; simulation safe.

title: I²C Protocol — Master and Spy
description: Connect external 3.3 V pull-ups and a suitable sensor/EEPROM. Address is 7-bit (e.g. 0x48). No output on load. Controller API example; simulation safe.

title: CAN Protocol — Classical CAN
description: AD3 DIO pins MUST use a suitable 3.3 V CAN transceiver. NEVER connect DIO directly to CANH/CANL. Terminate bus properly. Controller API example; simulation safe.

title: SWD Protocol — Target Registers
description: Only connect a voltage-compatible 3.3 V debug target with common GND. Read-only demonstration; never writes registers automatically. Controller API example; simulation safe.

title: UART Asynchronous Lab — Native Terminal, Callbacks and Test
description: Three Pages: C++ RX Terminal, JavaScript onData callback and project-owned 5-byte Test Executive echo. DIO0 -> 1 kΩ -> DIO1. No output until configured.

title: PC Serial — Text & Binary
description: PC Serial text/binary communications, visual button-event bindings, device event callbacks.

title: TCP Local Client/Server — Text & Binary
description: Local TCP text/binary client/server echo with visual button-event bindings.

title: UDP Local Datagram Echo — Text & Binary
description: Local UDP datagrams with text/binary echo and visual button-event bindings.

title: Communications Terminal — Serial / TCP / UDP
description: Three-page TCP/UDP/Serial Terminal: Property Editor-managed sendRequested(payload) and operator events.
